acceptanceCriteria: Each case has a regression test that fails before the fix.
(1) is not callable; (2) copies only the matching statement; (3) LoadMap refuses or the scaffold declines the call with a stated reason.
body: Codex review round 7 of the V1-0956 lane (issue 657, branch claude/gh657 head 6a1dab87), recorded in docs/build-log/2026-10-07-application-map.md and left unfixed under the 3-round review cap: (1) an object-literal method assigned to a class field (`helpers = { async book() {} }`) counts as a callable page-object method because class-body depth is not tracked (internal/appmap/tests.go:181); (2) two import statements on one line each get the whole line as their statement, so the scaffold duplicates bindings (statementAt, internal/appmap/tests.go:325); (3) a loaded map with a selector of strength unknown and a filled reuse list still produces a method call because LoadMap does not check it (internal/appmap/scaffold.go:133).
title: appmap: three review findings left open by the V1-0956 lane (object-literal class field methods, two imports on one line, unknown-strength selector reuse)
